304 Anchor — Interior

2nd floor
Time of day
Colors
Move: W A S D glide level with the floor in the direction you face · ↑ ↓ and the mouse wheel same as W / S · ← → turn in place · Space / C (or E / Q) up & down · Shift fast · above 40 ft everything moves 8× faster
Look: click the scene to capture the mouse, or hold the button and drag · Esc releases
Height: keys 1–9 put the camera that many feet above the 2nd floor; 0 = 10 ft, G = ground level, R = 5 ft above the roof, H = back to the starting spot · F = next fireplace design (10 designs, then none) · T = next time of day
Surroundings: terrain from the USGS elevation model; beach / water / ground from satellite imagery; houses and walks from OpenStreetMap; lighthouse at its surveyed position (its light turns counter-clockwise and flashes at you every 7.5 s, like the real one — the beam itself is not visible in the air). Neighbors are simple boxes at their mapped footprints. Sky colour is computed from the sun's position (Preetham atmospheric-scattering model, as used by the three.js sky example). Clouds drift on a 5 mph south-west breeze; stars come out at night; sailboats sit in the bay.
Click the scene to start — W A S D to move
